verdict.rationale: Flagsmith's docs say audit-log events can be streamed to your own infrastructure through Audit Log Webhooks. That is a first-party outbound HTTP callback, and since every admin action is logged, it covers a broad event stream. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, and only audit-log events are shown as subscribable. missing for 10: webhooks for flag-change or environment events beyond audit logs, documentation of webhook registration via API/UI, payload schema, signing/verification, retry semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can stream your Audit Logs into your own infrastructure using Audit Log Webhooks.
Every action taken within the Flagsmith administration application is tracked and logged.
